differs.mechanic: The concentric rings roll apart along one line and each becomes an empty seal that a travelling press stamps in turn, instead of requests passing inward through the rings and one being stopped.
differs.layout: A full-width row of five lettered seals under a top-spanning heading, with a status line across the foot, instead of a target of rings on the left beside a copy and audit-log column.
differs.data: A list of credentials with audit dates whose control counts sum into one passing total (0 to 212 of 212), instead of three requests tallied allowed versus blocked.
differs.moment: The full row stamped, every seal inked and dated with the bar full; the parent is remembered for the access-policy ring closing round on a blocked request.

blurb: The control rings roll apart into a row of seals; a press stamps each framework with its audit date while the passing controls add up.
